title: File:Mary Celeste as Amazon in 1861.jpg
author: Unconfirmed, possibly Honore Pellegrin (1800–c.1870). This speculative attribution is suggested in Paul Begg: Mary Celeste: The Greatest Mystery of the Sea. Longmans Education Ltd, Harlow (UK) 2007. Plate 2
date: 1861 : the inscription below the painting reads: "Amazon of Parrsboro. J.N. Parker, Commander, entering Marseilles, Nov'b'r 1861". See Begg, p. 18.
